count.description: Single bounded search count. The plugin has no cursor and does not accept unbounded counts.

PluginSearchRequest.description: Wire request for POST /api/Plugin/ext/napcat-plugin-cleaner/search-group. The canonical plugin registration ID is napcat-plugin-cleaner; the legacy dxc-join-api path is not part of this contract.

group_id.description: Actual local plugin wire ID, numeric int64. Core normalization converts it to a decimal QQId string before it leaves the adapter.

PluginGroup.description: One plugin search hit. A group name is display data and never an identity.

PluginSearchResponse.description: Wire response for POST /api/Plugin/ext/napcat-plugin-cleaner/search-group. No cursor is returned. Failure bodies are adapter errors and are never candidate evidence.

group_id.description: Actual local plugin wire ID, numeric int64. Core QQ identity remains the decimal string form.

confirm.description: The plugin wire confirmation must be the string "1"; numeric 1 is not the contract shape.

reason.description: Operator-approved application text. It is forwarded as the native richMsg field but is not proof of approval.

answer.description: Required operator-approved group question answer. It is forwarded as the native applyMsg field; an empty answer is rejected before dispatch.

PluginJoinRequest.description: Wire request for POST /api/Plugin/ext/napcat-plugin-cleaner/join-group. Canonical path only; do not call the legacy dxc-join-api path. After dispatch, any ambiguous transport or missing result is UNKNOWN and must be reconciled, never retried automatically.

result.description: Plugin result code. Only a finite non-negative safe integer is a code; a numeric code only proves that the plugin returned one, not membership or approval. Missing/unparseable/non-integral/negative results use the failure branch.

oneOf.description: Bounded JSON/text diagnostic; null represents a void native return. Runtime serialization is bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes including escapes.
Finite non-negative safe integer returned as-is by the native API.

Bounded opaque plugin echo for evidence/diagnostics only. Arrays, oversized objects (>64 properties), and special objects degrade to a bounded string. It must not be parsed as an authoritative membership claim.

raw.description: Bounded native return diagnostics, retained even when a numeric result was extracted. Allowed shapes: null, finite non-negative safe integer, string, or a plain object of at most 64 properties.

request_ref.description: Optional native request reference extracted for correlation; it is not membership confirmation.

result.description: Optional finite non-negative safe integer code from the failure path; it never proves membership.

oneOf.description: Bounded JSON/text diagnostic; null represents a void native return. Runtime serialization is bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes including escapes.
Finite non-negative safe integer returned as-is by the native API.

Bounded opaque plugin echo for evidence/diagnostics only. Arrays, oversized objects (>64 properties), and special objects degrade to a bounded string. It must not be parsed as an authoritative membership claim.

raw.description: Bounded native exception/return diagnostics. Allowed shapes: null, finite non-negative safe integer, string, or a plain object of at most 64 properties.

request_ref.description: Optional native request reference extracted for correlation; it is not membership confirmation.

PluginJoinResponse.description: Wire response for POST /api/Plugin/ext/napcat-plugin-cleaner/join-group. ok=true with a result code means only that the plugin returned a code; submitted/pending/unknown are not membership success. A void/absent result is ambiguous, must be stored UNKNOWN, and must never be converted into confirmed success.
